answer: A delegated quota ledger gives each vetted sponsor 10 daily service slots shared across ferrous sorting, orchard mapping and zephyr forecasting. Creating a child agent transfers slots from its sponsor; it never mints slots. The verifier atomically debits the parent balance and rejects requests without an unspent slot, including transfers through grandchildren. Thus 100 aliases descended from one sponsor still receive at most 10 services per day. The limit depends on vetting initial sponsors; duplicate sponsor enrollment breaks it.
